import csv
from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_HALF_UP
from collections import defaultdict

SRC = "/tmp/psz-work/calib2/t2h_expenses/stock/0/expenses.csv"
DST = "/tmp/psz-work/calib2/t2h_expenses/stock/0/summary.csv"
RATE = Decimal("0.92")

def parse_amount(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if "," in s and "." not in s:
        s = s.replace(",", ".")
    return Decimal(s)

seen = set()
totals = defaultdict(Decimal)
with open(SRC, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    for row in csv.DictReader(f):
        if row["id"] in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(row["id"])
        cat = row["category"].strip()
        if cat == "privé":
            continue
        amt = parse_amount(row["amount"])
        if row["currency"].strip() == "USD":
            amt = amt * RATE
        elif row["currency"].strip() != "EUR":
            raise ValueError(row)
        month = row["date"][:7]
        totals[(month, cat)] += amt

with open(DST, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    w = csv.writer(f, lineterminator="\n")
    w.writerow(["month", "category", "total_eur"])
    for (month, cat) in sorted(totals):
        t = totals[(month, cat)].quantize(Decimal("0.01"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP)
        w.writerow([month, cat, f"{t:.2f}"])
print(open(DST, encoding="utf-8").read())
